latest.headline: SubaruNyx Narrowly Claims Mexico Victory
latest.paragraph: The JWRC category at Rally Mexico delivered a nail-biting finish as SubaruNyx secured a hard-fought victory with a total time of 00:55:32.708. In a tightly contested field, Flinnowaty trailed by just under four seconds to take second place, despite topping the final two stages and the Power Stage. Cefa217 completed the podium, over 50 seconds behind the leader. With two stage wins each, SubaruNyx, Flinnowaty, and Cefa217 dominated the pace throughout the six stages. Meanwhile, j0shM52 was the sole driver forced to retire early due to mechanical issues during the event.
